idea-plugin.name: Desert
idea-plugin.description:
Desert is a port of Hans Fugal's classic desert.vim colour scheme to the JetBrains platform.

Warm sand and khaki on a soft charcoal background, with sky-blue comments, pale-green functions and olive selections - the same palette vim users have been staring at since 2003.

Ships two themes: Desert, a transcription of the vim original, and Desert Light, a derived light counterpart on a parchment ground taken from desert's own sand. Each comes with a matching editor scheme.
